title: What Your Body Is Doing While You Sleep

post_description: What happens to your heart, memory and immune system during sleep, from NIH and CDC. Sources: National Institutes of Health https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/sleep/why-sleep-important and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention https://www.cdc.gov/sleep/about/index.html #Science #ScienceFacts #QuantaTale
narration: Is sleep really just your body switching off? No, during sleep your body works to support brain function and keep you physically healthy. When you drift into non-REM sleep, blood pressure and heart rate fall. Sleep also helps you learn and form long-term memories. People who sleep too little may be more likely to catch colds and other infections. Quality sleep is uninterrupted and refreshing, not just long. And the hours you need change as you get older.
